Name: No Seeds For Coin - Seed Shortage
Author: Pokkki
Description:
[center][color=#b4a7d6][size=6][b]What does it do?[/b][/size][/color][size=3]

[/size][color=#ff0000][size=4]T[/size][/color][size=4]his mod aims to remove all seeds which can be purchased with coins from shops in and around the valley, unless there is a lore reason for the shop to have those seeds. That means the travelling cart might still have those seeds, who knows. Better go looking every Friday and Sunday!

[color=#e69138]D[/color]ue to technical constraints, seeds from Cornucopia - More Flowers/More Crops don't want to be removed from Joja Mart for now. I like to pretend Joja Mart used very unethical methods to secure their monopoly on these seeds. (If you're playing with SVE, vanilla seeds might show up still as well due to SVE tweaking the seed prices)

[color=#f1c232]T[/color]his mod was inspired by, and part of the code comes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21573]Find Your Own Seeds[/url] by Nein. I started playing with that and then wanted seeds from mods to be removed, too, as well as having the possibility to have modular settings so that modded seeds can be toggled individually to fit personal playstyle or lore.

[color=#6aa84f]M[/color]aybe some seeds are available since they're getting imported from elsewhere not impacted by whatever makes seeds unavailable in Pelican Town, maybe in the second year suddenly all seeds are available again because Caroline expanded her sunroom to extreme dimensions and started going into the seeds business to supply Pierre's shop; whatever you imagine, change up the settings and make it fit.

[color=#3c78d8]I[/color]f you do want some seeds to still be purchasable, the mod can be configured to enable seeds again at any time. Seeds that can't be purchased with coins still are available, bartering is heavily supported. I might add an option to remove those seeds as well in a later update.[/size][size=3]


[/size][color=#b4a7d6][size=6][b][font=Arial]Recommended[/font]:[/b][/size][/color][size=3]

[/size][color=#b4a7d6][size=4]I[/size][/color][size=4]t's encouraged to combine this mod with the following mods for still challenging, but balanced gameplay:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22311]Re-Mixed Seeds[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12849]Mixed Seeds From Forage
[/url][/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26712]More Mixed Seeds from Weeds[/url]﻿[/size]
[size=3] [/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿: I decided not to take away Jeric's livelihood by removing all seeds from his shop, as he doesn't sell anything else and I'd hate to see his shop completely empty. Neither did I remove seeds from Heap's store, as their wares are scarce already, they can have a few seeds as a treat for now. I might change my mind on that at some point.[/size]
[/center][size=6]

[size=5][b][color=#b4a7d6][center][size=6]To install:[/size][/center][/color] [/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.[/size]
[*][size=4]Download this mod.[/size]
[*][size=4]Unpack the zip file you downloaded.[/size]
[*][size=4]Put the folder from the unpacked zip file into your mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=4]The mod is now installed. A config file generates upon loading up the game [/size]
[size=4]and can either be accessed directly in the mod folder, or via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿. Anything can be toggled on and off at any point, changes should apply immediately.[/size]
[*][size=4]If you run into problems with installing this mod, best go to the [url=https://discord.com/invite/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord [/url]﻿and ask for help there.[/size]

[/list]
